item.title: NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices from 1880 to 2025 — Oct 15, 2026 · 5:30 AM ET
item.description: - **NBER study finds no systematic political bias in election prediction market prices from 1880 to 2025** — RotoWire reports an October 2026 NBER working paper by Eric Zitzewitz assembled election prediction market data spanning 1880 to 2025, covering venues from the Iowa Electronic Markets and PredictIt to Kalshi. The study found the full-sample bias estimate was essentially zero, with no statistically significant partisan tilt at one-day, three-week or four-month horizons. ([RotoWire](https://www.rotowire.com/article/prediction-markets-go-back-to-future-with-election-trades-139104))

item.title: S&P Global survey finds 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts — Oct 15, 2026 · 2:15 AM ET
item.description: - **S&P Global survey finds 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts** — A third quarter 2026 S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan survey found just 10 percent of respondents traded on a yes or no exchange in the past year, and among those users 70 percent traded sports contracts, ahead of financial outcomes at 36 percent and political outcomes at 33 percent. The survey also found 61 percent of traders are under 35 and 44 percent of respondents had never heard of prediction markets. item.description: - **Kalshi seeks approval for about 60 stock perpetual futures including Tesla, Apple and Nvidia** — Kalshi has asked the CFTC and SEC to approve nearly 60 perpetual futures contracts tied to stocks and ETFs worth at least 100 billion dollars, including Tesla, Apple and Nvidia, with each contract representing 100 shares at roughly 15 percent margin. item.title: CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers — Oct 15, 2026 · 2:15 AM ET
item.description: - **CFTC October 9 actions draw a line between event contracts and casino or sportsbook wagers** — On October 9 the CFTC issued an interim final rule and a separate proposal that would treat sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as swaps under federal derivatives oversight, while casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers stay outside that definition. Federal appeals courts remain divided over sports contract jurisdiction, with the NFL backing state oversight and Robinhood backing exclusive federal authority. ([Cryptonomist](https://en.cryptonomist.ch/2026/10/10/cftc-prediction-markets-regulation-2/))

item.description: - **Forkast shuts down its esports prediction market after a 100 million dollar run** — The Esports Advocate reports Forkast announced on October 12 that it is winding down, with withdrawals open until November 9 and automated agent trading pausing October 15. item.title: Polymarket's Coplan says blockchain made small, specialised event markets viable — Oct 15, 2026 · 1:00 AM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket's Coplan says blockchain made small, specialised event markets viable** — The Asian Banker reports Shayne Coplan describing how Polymarket creates markets on events of any size and turns the resulting prices into a public information source. item.title: FCA confirms talks as Polymarket and Kalshi consider a UK launch, CCN reports — Oct 15, 2026 · 12:45 AM ET

item.title: Ohio orders 10 prediction markets and brokers to stop sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 8:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction markets and brokers to stop sports contracts** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission sent cease-and-desist letters dated October 2 to 10 operators and brokers, including Polymarket, Coinbase, Robinhood, Webull and Novig, ordering them to stop offering sports event contracts to Ohio residents. Each recipient must confirm compliance in writing within 14 days, a deadline falling on October 16, following the Sixth Circuit ruling that Ohio can enforce its gambling laws against the contracts. ([iGaming Times](https://igaming-times.com/news/prediction-markets/ohio-orders-10-prediction-markets-to-stop-sports-contracts-a-week-after-its-sixth-circuit-win))
